newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Endesa mulls new Colombia plants.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Endesa mulls new Colombia plants.

text.p: Chile's largest power utility Empresa Nacional de Electricidad (Endesa) is carrying out feasibility studies on two new electricity plants in Colombia, said an official at the company.
"Endesa is continuing to carry out feasibilty studies on two plants in Colombia," the source, who declined to be identified, told Reuters.
The plans include a hydroelectric plant in the Rio Paez region in south-western Colombia and a thermal plant near the city of Neiva.
The official declined to give details of the size of the plants or when they would be built.
Endesa started to invest in Colombia last year when it headed a consortium which bought the Betania power plant from the government for $302 million.
